items.rss_summary: A Russian navy corvette docked at the Benghazi naval base ​in eastern Libya was hit on Sunday by a suspected Ukrainian sea drone, according to local officials. The strike severely damaged the warship and ignited a fire at the facility in what appeared to be the latest attack in Libya linked to the Russia-Ukraine war.
